problem: app.js ignored existing auth=manual/signed-out/expired entry intent and awaited push cleanup before Auth sign-out. Reload during that delay could restore the saved SDK session into application verification.
evidence_scope: Actual prior source reproduced with a synthetic leftover session and delayed push cleanup. This establishes a source-level trigger consistent with the owner report, not the sole live cause or provider/cookie state.
behavior: Write nonsecret sign-out URL intent, invalidate entry tickets and clear private views synchronously before waiting for cleanup or SDK logout.
Honor existing manual/signed-out/expired intent during startup and nonnull Auth events, showing sign-in instead of automatically opening verification.
Keep a leftover SDK session only for explicit sign-out retry, with a persistent warning when logout did not finish.
Keep current-account guard and duplicate-attempt guard around asynchronous sign-out.
Release manual intent only after successful password authentication matches the current SDK actor and access token.
Ordinary saved-session startup without manual intent still uses the existing server verification path.
Version the app module to119 and use the existing notice styling for the explicit retry.
security_invariants: URL intent is denial/presentation only. It cannot create application proof, authorize protected views or declare SDK logout successful.
No protected entry ticket/session is exposed from manual sign-in UI.
Failed password or mismatched actor/token cannot reopen the saved account.
No private browser storage deletion or fabricated proof. Existing server gate, device approval, Admin assurance and bounded window remain required.
No SQL, gateway/worker, Auth configuration, callback route, account or mail-provider changes.
package_checks: Exact input digest, historical entry provenance, raw-source/staging-output identities, unchanged42 entries and input, complete ZIP readback, safe refusal.
acceptance_scope: After exit0/upload, sign out on the fresh canonical app and reload once. Expect sign-in form, no Verify your sign-in. Report persistent warning if logout failed. This single UI check does not close all cleanup, failure, account-switch or Business variants.
